entry_before.title_zh: 元吸引子与选择条件的重建
entry_before.title_en: Meta-attractors and reproduction of selection conditions
entry_before.claim_zh: 活动后果参与重建选择该组织的条件，使其经具体承载者变化仍能接续；区分机制条件、实际边界、动力学接近及可行纠正。 新会话进一步检验精确局部目标执行怎样经制度后果进入共同损失；局部安全与共同执行保护分列。 Ren 后续提出复杂性增长与实际认知／行动能力失配的退化候选；区别需求、回应、损失与修复。 条件接续已证明逐前缀支持与内生回应受损，并保留可负担恢复及需求调整。 可纠正性接续区分实际回应能力与接受目的修订的动机。 纠正依存模型接通退出负担、真实请求、后继配合及共同支持。 实际担保与检查结算可在明确条件下把有代价纠正变为最优选择。 当前方向依 Ren 纠正为共同组织中的调节形成、分化整合与持续修订；不以利益对立或监管不可靠为一般起点。 共同探究可修订问题表述与目的，当前检验是新根据怎样进入正在执行的共同任务。
entry_before.claim_en: Consequences help reproduce conditions selecting an organization across carrier changes; distinguish mechanism conditions, formed boundaries, dynamical approach and feasible correction. A new session tests how exact local objective fidelity can lead through institutional consequences to collective loss; local safety and joint-execution protection remain distinct. Ren subsequently proposes degeneration through a mismatch between growing complexity and effective cognition/action; demand, response, loss and repair remain distinct. The conditional continuation now proves prefix support and endogenous response impairment, retaining affordable recovery and demand adjustment. The corrigibility assessment distinguishes effective response from willingness to revise ends. Correction dependence connects exit burdens, truthful requests, successor cooperation and shared provision. Actual stake posting and audit settlement can make costly correction optimal under explicit conditions. Ren’s current correction makes regulatory formation, differentiation, integration and continuing revision within common organization the next focus, without presupposing opposed interests or untrustworthy supervision. Joint inquiry can revise problem formulations and purposes; the current test is how revised grounds enter a shared task already underway.
entry_before.scope_zh: 原47／65、承载者40／69、再生58／107、判准34／56、检验改组43／87、干预发现另43／87各轮定理／审计保留。拓展探究新增54项 Lean 定理／99项审计：材料制造与安装扩大干预深度，预留解除中断及恢复能力，接通任意有限轮次、范围内故障认证与实际回应。每一有限隐藏合并可由继续拓展揭示，但有限效果记录不能自证无限分离。稳定嵌套依存、构造与供给、实际送达及记录忠实仍为前提；范围内实践认证不以全知为门槛。不宣称普遍层级、完整理论或独立验收。1,024项网络探索不计作证明。 集体破坏第一构造另有32项新定理／41项审计，检查两位置阶段最优化、正且可增长吞吐下的有限到达、精确盆地及严格保护；平局失败与无法自动恢复保留。接续新增71项定理／100项审计，接通有限人口替换、内部筹资、恢复／耗尽精确分界及材料约束下的核心接续；恢复前归零、分流与缺件失败保留。到墙范围是实际征收、证据、权限与承诺的形成和维护，未宣称普遍收敛或经验对应。 新的普遍连接与当前社会诊断仍为候选，已有证明不冒充指数复杂性或必然崩溃的证明。 回应接续新增46项定理／53项审计，涵盖明确指数需求／线性回应特例和所有可负担当期留存支持最优策略的失败；认识的实际形成及社会对应仍开放。 Corrigibility 概念整合无新增证明；规范理由、执行协议与局部维持不构成完整解决。 再增38项定理／61项审计：服从下的依存固化、原任务全部最优方案的损害、受约束的有代价纠正与共同退出分界；动机、真实负担与正当权限仍须解释。 承诺接续再增35项定理／47项审计，检查全部最优方案、实际关闭、区分度与有限资源界限；误罚、近似选择、参与及串通反例保留，内在关切和监管自身形成未证。 此次非二元方向纠正不新增证明；中枢整合、合作下失败及关系改组须进入后续比较，博弈与担保结果须有局部对应，既有完成范围不变。 共同问题接续复用目的修订及变化中传达的既有结果；新组合未证，供水情境为示例，Ostrom 指定段落为有限来源比较。
entry_before.scope_en: Earlier theorem/audit packages 47/65, carrier 40/69, reproduction 58/107, admission 34/56, testing reorganization 43/87 and separate discovery 43/87 retain their scopes. Expanding inquiry adds 54 theorems/99 audits: material fabrication and installation deepen access, reserved restoration keeps interrupted inquiry executable, and arbitrary finite rounds join covered-fault certification to actual response. Each finite hidden merger is exposed by continued expansion, but finite effect records cannot certify unrestricted separation. Stable nested dependence, construction, supply, delivery and faithful records remain premises; bounded practical warrant does not require omniscience. No universal hierarchy, complete theory or independent acceptance is claimed. The 1,024 network explorations are not proofs. A separate first collective-destruction construction adds 32 theorems / 41 audits for two-position stage optimization, finite arrival under positive and possibly growing throughput, an exact basin and strict protection, retaining tie failure and absent automatic recovery. The continuation adds 71 theorems / 100 audits for bounded population replacement, internally financed correction, exact recovery/destruction boundaries and material-guarded core histories. Interim loss, diversion and missing-parts failures remain. The wall is formation and preservation of actual collection, evidence, authority and commitments; universal convergence and empirical correspondence are not established. The broader implication and diagnosis of current society remain hypotheses; existing proofs establish neither exponential societal complexity nor inevitable collapse. The response continuation adds 46 theorems / 53 audits, including a specified exponential-demand/linear-response case and failure of all affordable immediate-support-optimal policies. Actual cognitive realization and societal correspondence remain open. The conceptual corrigibility integration adds no proof; normative reasons, execution protocols and local maintenance do not constitute a full solution. A further 38 theorems / 61 audits cover entrenchment despite obedience, harmful unrestricted task optima, costly constrained correction and joint exit capacity; motivation, actual burdens and legitimate authority remain explicit obligations. The commitment continuation adds 35 theorems / 47 audits for all optimizing plans, actual shutdown, discrimination and finite-resource bounds; false positives, approximate choice, participation and collusion remain, without deriving intrinsic concern or oversight formation. This nondual direction correction adds no proof: integrated regulation, cooperative failure and relational reorganization enter the next comparison; strategic and stake models require local correspondence, with completed scopes unchanged. The joint-problem continuation reuses completed purpose-revision and changing-delivery results; their new composition remains unproved, the water example is illustrative, and selected Ostrom passages supply a bounded source comparison.
